sect1.title: glycin-&glycin-version;

sect2.title: Installation of glycin
sect2.para: If installing Xorg into /opt, download the needed Rust crates now and apply a patch to allow accessing $XORG_PREFIX/lib from the sandbox (note that the patch requires XORG_PREFIX set properly for the current user and &root; following before building glycin):
Install glycin by running the following commands:

screen.userinput:
mkdir build && cd build &&
meson setup --prefix=/usr \ --buildtype=release \ -D libglycin-gtk4=false \ -D tests=false .. && ninja

sect2.para: If you have installed , you can build the documentation by issuing:

screen.userinput:
sed "/install_dir:.*doc/s|,$| / 'glycin-' + meson.project_version()&|" \ -i ../libglycin/meson.build &&
meson configure -D capi_docs=true && ninja

sect2.para: To test the results, ensure is installed, then issue: meson configure -D tests=true && ninja test.

sect2.title: Command Explanations
sect2.para: -D glycin_gtk4=false: This parameter disables the build of libglycin-gtk4 (which is not used by any BLFS packages yet) so this package can be built without installed.

-D glycin-loaders=...: Use this option to specify the image loaders to be built. The default is glycin-heif,glycin-image-rs,glycin-jxl,glycin-svg, covering the support for all commonly used image formats. You may remove the glycin-heif, glycin-jxl, or glycin-svg loader if the corresponding recommended dependency is not installed, but doing so will cause test failures and hamper the functionality of this package. There are also loaders for the JPEG 2000 and RAW formats but they are not enabled by default.
-D vapi=false: This option allows building this package without installed.

listitem.para: creates thumbnails for images in a format supported by glycin
contains image load functions which work by running glycin loaders in a sandbox environment
